home_subtitle: Section 1 句式精讲 · 有些……如此……
part1_desc: 第 1–27 步：some...others...、so...that...、completely、original、birth、sound；读《我们班》，练习帮做题过关。
part2_desc: 第 28–50 步：读《出生与原名》，独立验证本课句式；写作帮用 so...that... 写一句话。
note: 本课阅读材料为教研自编，非课本原文。考查能力：some...others... 与 some...the others... 的区别、so...that...（与 such...that... 的区别、与 too...to... / not...enough to... 的互换）、completely、original（原名/独创的/原件）、birth（year/date/place of birth）、sound（形容词合理的）。Unit 1 Look it up! 主题，核心句 Some were as small as chickens, and others were as big as ten elephants. / They are so smart that they can be trained to understand some human language.

steps.title: 广播站新任务：有些……如此……
steps.teach_html:
广播站今天讲“对比”和“结果”：有些人喜欢读书，另一些人喜欢运动；一本书有趣到什么程度，才会让全班都喜欢它？

这一课讲六个新点：some...others...（一些……另一些……）、so...that...（如此……以至于……）、completely（完全地）、original（原来的）、birth（出生）、sound（合理的；正确的）。

steps.title: 教材帮：some...others... 一些……另一些……
steps.teach_html:
some...others... 一些……另一些……。others 在这里表示泛指，表示另外的一部分。

Some were as small as chickens, and others were as big as ten elephants. 有些恐龙像鸡一样小，另一些则有十头大象那么大。

Some students like English, and others like maths. 有些学生喜欢英语，另一些喜欢数学。

记住：others 是代词，后面不加名词；other 是形容词，后面要加名词。

steps.title: 教材帮：some...the others... 一些……其余的……
steps.teach_html:
some...the others... 表示“一些……其余的……”，the others 表示一定范围内除去一部分后剩下的全部。

There are thirty students in our class. Some like reading, and the others like sports. 我们班有三十个学生，有些喜欢读书，其余的喜欢运动。

对比一下：some...others... 是“一些……另外一些……”；some...the others... 是“一些……其余的（全部）……”。看清说的是不是“剩下的人全都”。

steps.title: 教材帮：so...that... 如此……以至于……
steps.teach_html:
so...that... 如此……以至于……，引导结果状语从句。so 是副词，后接形容词或副词。

They are so smart that they can be trained to understand some human language. 它们十分聪明，以至于能够被训练来理解一些人类语言。

This book is so interesting that we all like it. 这本书如此有趣，以至于我们都喜欢它。

和它长得很像的是 such...that...：such 是限定词，后接名词（短语）。This is such an interesting book that we all like it. 这本书如此有趣，以至于我们都喜欢它。

steps.title: 教材帮：so...that... 换说法
steps.teach_html:
so...that... 可以换成另外两种说法，意思一样：

The man is so weak that he can't swim across the river. 这个人如此虚弱，以至于不能游过那条河。

= The man is too weak to swim across the river.（too...to... 太……而不能……）

= The man is not strong enough to swim across the river.（not...enough to... 不够……而不能……）

换的时候注意：too...to... 用“弱”本身；not...enough to... 要换成反义词“强壮”。考试常考这个互换。

steps.title: 教材帮：completely 完全地；彻底地
steps.teach_html:
completely /kəmˈpliːtli/ adv. 完全地；彻底地。由 complete（adj. 完全的；彻底的）+ -ly（副词后缀）构成。

Scientists are not completely sure why. 科学家们并不完全确定其中的原因。

Turn the lights completely off before you leave. 离开之前把灯完全关掉。

记住：complete 是形容词，修饰名词；completely 是副词，修饰动词或形容词。

steps.title: 教材帮：original 原来的；起初的
steps.teach_html:
original /əˈrɪdʒənl/ adj. 原来的；起初的。由 origin（n. 起源；起因）+ -al（形容词后缀）构成，通常用于名词前作定语。

original name 原名：Her original name was Lin Xiaohua. 她的原名是林小华。

The original idea of forming a band was to make music class interesting. 组建乐队的最初想法是为了让音乐课变得有趣。

original 还有两个意思：(1) 独创的；新颖的：That's not a very original suggestion. 那个建议没什么新意。(2) 原件；原作（名词）：This painting is a copy, and the original is in the Louvre. 这幅画是复制品，原作在卢浮宫。

steps.title: 教材帮：birth 出生
steps.teach_html:
birth /bɜːθ/ n. 出生。常用搭配：year/date/place of birth 出生年／出生日期／出生地；at birth 出生时；give birth to 生（孩子）。

The year of his birth was 1452. 他出生的年份是 1452 年。

分清一组词：birth 是名词“出生”；born 是 be born 的一部分；death 是名词“死；死亡”；die 是动词“死”；dead 是形容词“死的”；dying 是形容词“临终的”。

steps.title: 教材帮：sound 合理的；正确的；可靠的
steps.teach_html:
sound /saʊnd/ adj. 合理的；正确的；可靠的。

He gave me some very sound advice. 他给了我一些非常合理的建议。

What he said about the new project seems quite sound. 他对这个新项目的看法似乎很合理。

sound 还是个多义词：作名词是“声音；响声”（make a sound 发出声音）；作动词是“听起来；好像”，后常接形容词作表语（The music sounds too noisy. 音乐听起来太吵了。）；作形容词还有“完好的；健康的”（safe and sound 安然无恙）。

steps.title: 翻译帮：阅读材料——我们班
steps.teach_html:
下面是一段自编短文，讲我们班。读两遍，找一找：班里有些人喜欢什么、另一些人喜欢什么？那本恐龙书写得有多有趣？科学家们对恐龙灭绝的原因确定吗？

读的时候用扫描的方法：先看问题，再到文章里找答案。

steps.title: 练习帮：others 是什么意思
steps.scene: 班里有些人喜欢读书，另一些人喜欢运动。
steps.stem: “Some like reading, and others like sports.” What does “others” mean here?
steps.help: others 指的是班里另外的一部分人，哪个选项是这个意思？
steps.explain: Others means other students in the class. others 是“班里另外一些学生”。

wrong_feedback.A: all the students 是“所有学生”，some 和 others 加起来才是全部。
wrong_feedback.B: the teacher 是“老师”，others 说的是学生。
wrong_feedback.C: students in another school 是“别的学校的学生”，others 说的是本班学生。

steps.reading: Our class has thirty students. Some like reading, and others like sports. Some read books about animals, and others read books about space. Last week, we read about dinosaurs. The book was so interesting that we all liked it. Some dinosaurs were so big that they could not run fast. Others were so small that they could hide in the grass. Our teacher says, 'Dinosaurs are so interesting that scientists still study them today.' We are not completely sure why they died out. Some scientists think the weather changed completely. Others think a big rock fell from the sky. We all want to know the answer.

steps.help: “另外一些人”，填哪个代词？后面不加名词。
steps.explain: Some read books about animals, and others read books about space. 有些人读动物书，另一些人读太空书。

common_errors.say: others 是代词“另外一些人”；other 是形容词，后面要加名词。
another 是“另一个”，这里是“另外一些人”，用 others。

steps.title: 写作帮：用 so...that... 写一句话
steps.teach_html:
用 so...that... 写一句话，三步就够：

先说“有多……”：so + 形容词，比如 so interesting、so tired。

再说结果：that + 从句，比如 that we all like it、that he cannot walk any more。

范文两句记下来：The book is so interesting that we all like it. / The music was so loud that we could not hear each other.

steps.title: 练习帮：哪个 so...that... 句子是对的

The music was so loud that we could not hear each other.

steps.help: so 后面接形容词 loud，that 从句不能丢，哪个句子全写对了？
steps.explain: The music was so loud that we could not hear each other. so + 形容词 + that 从句。

wrong_feedback.A: such loud 不对，such 后面要加名词。
wrong_feedback.B: so loudly 不对，so 后面接形容词 loud，不用副词 loudly。
wrong_feedback.D: so loud so 不对，结果从句前面是 that，不是 so。

steps.title: 写作帮：用 so...that... 写一句话

steps.answer_text: The book is so interesting that we all like it.

steps.explain: The book is so interesting that we all like it. 这本书如此有趣，我们都喜欢它。

common_errors.say: so + 形容词 + that：so interesting that；such 后面要加名词。

common_errors.when: 只写了 so interesting，没有写 that 从句
common_errors.say: so...that... 要写完整：so interesting that we all like it。

common_errors.say: 结果是从句是否定的：cannot walk。
这道题练的是 so...that...：He is so tired that he cannot walk any more。

steps.title: 本课小结
steps.teach_html:
本课收官：some...others... 一些……另一些……，some...the others... 一些……其余的……；so...that... 如此……以至于……，可以换成 too...to... 和 not...enough to...；completely 完全地；original 原来的（还有“独创的”“原件”）；birth 出生（year of birth）；sound 合理的、正确的。

下一课是 Section 1 综合练：把达·芬奇和恐龙的故事放在一起考一考。站长先卖个关子。
